type PicodashDockPosition = Exclude<DashPanelDockPosition$1, 'full-top' | 'center-top' | 'full-bottom' | 'center-bottom'>;
type PicodashProviderProps<Fields extends PicodashFieldDefinitions = PicodashFieldDefinitions, CustomTheme extends string = never> = Omit<DashPanelProviderProps<Fields, CustomTheme>, 'dockPositions'> & {
  dockPositions?: readonly PicodashDockPosition[];
};
